container.definition:
Bootstrap: docker
From: python:3.12-slim

%files
    site-ca-bundle.crt /etc/pw-site-ca.crt

%post
    # the login node's CA bundle: a site whose proxy re-signs HTTPS is trusted in the build
    export SSL_CERT_FILE=/etc/pw-site-ca.crt PIP_CERT=/etc/pw-site-ca.crt REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE=/etc/pw-site-ca.crt CURL_CA_BUNDLE=/etc/pw-site-ca.crt GIT_SSL_CAINFO=/etc/pw-site-ca.crt
    pip install --no-cache-dir numpy==2.3.3

%environment
    export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
    export SSL_CERT_FILE=/etc/pw-site-ca.crt PIP_CERT=/etc/pw-site-ca.crt REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE=/etc/pw-site-ca.crt CURL_CA_BUNDLE=/etc/pw-site-ca.crt

%runscript
    exec python "$@"

%test
    python -c "import numpy; print('numpy', numpy.__version__)"
